name: DominoSlide – Slide & Carousel Maker
author: Digital Web Tutor

sections.description:
DominoSlide is designed to be a simple, lightweight slider widget for Elementor. It allows you to create fully responsive, customizable sliders directly in the Elementor page builder without bloating your site.

Features:
* Simple slider widget for Elementor.
* Fully responsive layout.
* Custom slides with Title, Description, Image, and Button options.
* Customizable slide height.
* Autoplay options.
* Pure vanilla JS/CSS implementation for fast page loading.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/dominoslide-slide-carousel-maker directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and active.
sections.faq:
Does it require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor is required to use this plugin.
